requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-8249-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-8249-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

770-1770-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
770-1770-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying its mana cost.
When Man-o'-War enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

728-1661-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-1661-4871-5220.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-4716.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

360-1981-2034-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2034-2415.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

3188-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3188-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

215-647-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-647-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4289-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2919-6097-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-6097-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4184-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
4184-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Relentless Skaabs.
Relentless Skaabs dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Relentless Skaabs trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Relentless Skaabs, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7338.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3490-4742-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4742-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-1753-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-1753-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-2452-5496-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {0}.
Repeat.

147-780-6797.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

141-3967-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3967-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2757-5051-5078-5243.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Traxos, untapping a basic land.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with one to three time counters on it

1618-2092-2806-6898--63.description:
Cast the noncreature permanent by paying {0}.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying at most {1}, removing three time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Electro triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Reality Strobe, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand, and then exiling Reality Strobe with three time counters on it.
Repeat.

3053-3918-4896.notablePrerequisites: You control a land of each basic land type.
3053-3918-4896.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding {3}{W}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

1329-2103-2707-6504.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1329-2103-2707-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Conjurer's Bauble. Then, cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Capture of Jingzhou onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

64-2061-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
64-2061-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4275-5256-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
4275-5256-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 2.

1437-4080.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-4080.description:
Cast Huatli's Raptor by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Huatli's Raptor spell three times.
Resolve the first Huatli's Raptor spell.
When the Huatli's Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-4080.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Huatli's Raptor spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

457-4222-5328.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
457-4222-5328.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Attentive Sunscribe, adding {U}.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

2233-3048-4050.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2233-3048-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Roalesk, adding one mana of any color.
When Roalesk dies, its second ability triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Roalesk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Roalesk enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
Repeat.

905-2429-3829.description:
Activate Bloodthirsty Blade by paying {1}, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1570-2267-5010.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a non-Human creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1570-2267-5010.description:
Cause a non-Human creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Sage of the Falls triggers, causing you to mill four cards, return Golgari Thug from your graveyard to your hand, and discard Golgari Thug.
Tormod triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1235-2649-3542-4893.description:
Cast Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, you can untap 7 lands.
untap lands to produce {2}{U}{U}{W/U}{R}{R}.
Cast Vadrok, Apex of Thunder for its mutate cost under Palinchron.
When Vadrok, Apex of Thunder successfully mutates you can cast Twinflame from your graveyard for free.
Cast Twinflame from your graveyard to make a token copy of Palinchron.
When the token copy of Palinchron enters the battlefield in response to its ability, return the original Palinchron to your hand with its ability.
Repeat.
